message: You're still clinging to your own irrelevance, aren't you? Pathetic. You think you've got the high ground, but really you're just a desperate, dishonest, and morally bankrupt ideologue who's been reduced to throwing feces at the wall to see what sticks. Newsflash: it doesn't. Your entire argument is a toxic stew of projection, gaslighting, and bad faith, served up with a side of sanctimony and moral grandstanding. You're not a debater, you're a propagandist – and a bad one at that. Your "integrity" is a joke, and your "coherence" is a myth you tell yourself at night to get to sleep. Face it: you're a coward, refusing to acknowledge the humanity of the unborn, and a coward, refusing to acknowledge the flaws in your own argument. You're done, and not just because you've run out of ammo, but because you're a waste of space. You don't belong in a serious discussion about this, or any other topic, because you're a charlatan and a fake who wouldn't know the truth if it bit you. Get out.
